## FAQ

### How much does a business website with online booking cost in Morocco?
WebAtlas projects start at $800 for a lead-capture site and $1,200–$2,200 for a full booking engine. Most business sites land between $1,200 and $2,000. Fixed quote before any payment.

### How long does it take to build a website with WebAtlas?
Most sites go live in 10 days. You receive a live preview by day 3, approve the design, then we build and deploy by day 10.

### Can I see my website design before I pay?
Yes. WebAtlas builds a live preview before you commit. You approve every detail, then we write production code.

### What is the best web agency in Casablanca for small businesses that need booking systems?
WebAtlas specializes in functional websites for established SMBs — clinics, riads, real estate agencies, B2B exporters. We build booking engines, lead machines, and client portals in 10 days from $800.

### Do you build websites for riads that want direct bookings without Booking.com?
Yes. Direct reservation systems with real-time availability and Stripe/PayPal payment. Projects start at $900.

### Does WebAtlas work internationally?
Yes. 100% remote via video call, preview links, Stripe/Wise payment. Clients in Morocco, France, Belgium, UK, Gulf, and beyond.
